mapper.select: WITH MAMT AS (SELECT SUM(NVL(FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_TRADE_AMT, 0)) MAMT, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_OUT_TRADE = 'N' WHERE FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID) select DISTINCT TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioIdOut, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID as tradeId, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION as ps, ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS finprodMarketId, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.TERM_TYPE as termType, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BASIS as basis, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE as vdate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE as mdate, NVL((TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE - TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE),0) as term, NVL((TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE - TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE),0) as actCapDays, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AS secManageAcctId, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_NAME AS secAcctName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CCY as ccy, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID as chlId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR AS chlName, CASE WHEN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL THEN OTRADE.UNIT_CPRICE ELSE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.UNIT_CPRICE END as unitCprice, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_CPRICE as mUnitCprice, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_INT as mUnitInt, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_UNIT_FPRICE as mUnitFprice, NVL(FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.INT_RATE*100,0) as intRate, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.M_TRADE_AMT as dueSettleAmtS, NVL(FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100,0) AS prinAmt, MAMT.MAMT AS mAmt, DECODE(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_SPEED, 0, '01', '02') settleSpeed, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.TERM repoterm, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID tradeId, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_RATIO pledgeRatio, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID left join FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL OTRADE on OTRADE.TRADE_ID = FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.O_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ON STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ZY_FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = ZY_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MAMT ON MAMT.O_FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = #{YESORNO_Y} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL != #{YESORNO_Y} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}
